description: Claim a task from the shared org Pool into your personal backlog (assignee = you). Atomic first-claim-wins — a concurrent double-claim is impossible. Cascades the DEPENDS ON chain: claiming a task also claims its not-Done prerequisites; if any prerequisite is already claimed by another member the whole claim is refused (a build unit is never split across owners). On a shared project, call `session_announce` when you start work and `session_list` to see who else is active before claiming — that surfaces collisions this tool cannot see on its own. Does not call the Anthropic API.
name: task_claim
